column11: 8 YEARS OF LOVE  ONE BROKEN HEART  AND A WHOLE LOT OF BEAGLE LEFT TO GIVE. MEET TOBY!Toby wasn't supposed to be looking for a new family at 8 years old.This sweet Beagle boy had a home. He had a person. He had a life he knew and loved. But sadly  when his beloved owner passed away  Toby's entire world changed overnight.Now  at 8 years young  Toby is searching for someone to love him through the next chapter of his life.And trust us  this handsome little guy has SO much love left to give!A LITTLE ABOUT TOBY!Age: 8 years young  with plenty of Beagle charm!Dog friendly: Yes! Toby gets along with other dogs and would be happy to have canine companions!Cat friendly: Absolutely! This sweet boy is good with feline friends  too!Personality: Toby is an incredibly sweet boy who is understandably feeling a little confused and anxious right now. After losing his person and everything familiar  who could blame him? He just needs a patient  loving family to help him feel safe and secure again.Fitness goals: Let's just say Toby has been enjoying the good life a LITTLE too much. He's currently sporting some extra Beagle fluff and will need a family committed to helping him shed a few pounds at a safe  healthy pace.Think leisurely walks  appropriate portions  and a whole lot of encouragement. Toby is officially entering his fitness era!But here's the thing about Toby.He doesn't know he's considered a senior.He doesn't know he's carrying a few extra pounds.And he certainly doesn't understand why the person he loved isn't coming home.All he knows is that his world has changed  and he's waiting for someone to make it feel right again.Toby doesn't need a perfect family. He just needs a family who will love him.Someone who understands that adjusting takes time. Someone who will celebrate the little victories as his confidence returns. Someone who will give him the security of knowing he's finally home again.At 8 years old  Toby deserves more than uncertainty. He deserves cozy beds  sniff-filled walks  gentle affection  and a family who will cherish every single day with him.His first chapter was filled with love. Let's make sure his next chapter is  too.Interested in making Toby part of your family? Apply to adopt through United Doberman Rescue & Canine Castaways of MN!https://www.uniteddobermanrescue.org/

MEET WINTER – YOUR POCKET-SIZED HUSKY!Who says you need a full-sized Husky to get all that Husky personality? Meet Winter  a handsome Husky mix who is basically a miniature version of the real thing!Originally from Louisiana  Winter weighs just 35 pounds and has all the classic Husky looks in a much smaller package! Don't let his size fool you  though. He's got all the typical Husky traits we know and love: he's smart  full of personality  and always ready to make life a little more entertaining!Winter loves everyone he meets and has a way of making friends wherever he goes. He's got that charming Husky spirit  a clever mind  and plenty of personality to keep his future family smiling.Winter does have one medical hurdle ahead of him. He is heartworm positive and officially started treatment on October 28  2026. He is getting the care he needs  and we're committed to helping him through this journey so he can enjoy the happy  healthy life he deserves.If you've always loved Huskies but wished they came in a smaller package  Winter might just be your perfect match!Could Winter be the missing piece to your family? He's ready to find his forever home and start his next adventure!Apply to adopt through United Doberman Rescue & Canine Castaways: https://www.uniteddobermanrescue.org/

MEET DIXIE: 2 YEARS OLD  ALL NATURAL  AND A FULL-TIME PROFESSIONAL SNUGGLER! Looking for a gorgeous Doberman girl who will love you unconditionally  follow you everywhere  and occasionally question your judgment when you ask her to go outside in the rain? Well  meet Dixie! Dixie is a beautiful 2-year-old  all-natural Doberman sweetheart with a whole lot of love to give and a personality that will keep you smiling! Let's talk about what makes Dixie so special! Dog friendly? Absolutely! Dixie enjoys her canine companions and would love having some four-legged friends around! Snuggle bug? That's practically her full-time job! Dixie is all about the cuddles  affection  and being as close to her humans as physically possible. Personal space is simply not in her vocabulary. If you wanted a dog who respects boundaries  you might want to keep scrolling! Sensitive Doberman princess? Oh  100%. Dixie has that classic Doberman sensitivity  especially when it comes to the WEATHER. Rain? Hard pass. Wet paws? Absolutely unacceptable. Being asked to go potty when water is literally FALLING FROM THE SKY? The audacity. Dixie would much rather be curled up somewhere warm and cozy  preferably under a blanket with her favorite human. And honestly  can we blame her? At just 2 years old  Dixie has so much life  love  and adventure ahead of her! She's looking for a family who will appreciate her sweet personality  embrace her Velcro Doberman tendencies  and understand that sometimes a princess simply does not wish to get her paws wet. If your dream dog is a beautiful  dog-friendly  affectionate Doberman who doubles as a personal space heater and professional cuddle companion  Dixie might just be your girl! Apply to adopt Dixie through United Doberman Rescue & Canine Castaways of MN! https://www.uniteddobermanrescue.org/

Meet River a 5 year old Dane X. River is a gentle giant with a heart as big as he is. This cat-loving Great Dane mix has white twinkle toes and a lover’s soul through and through.River is on his way to us from Louisiana  where there are far too many dogs and very few humans who care. The dogs there are just trying to survive each day  with only the rescuers to look out for them. River has been waiting in rescue for his forever home for far too long  and he is exactly the kind of dog UDR strives to help.When he arrives  River will be fostered in a home with other Danes  so he’ll have friends to enjoy and keep him company. He is crate and house trained  rock solid  and has truly been there  done that. He will be going through heartworm treatment once he is with us  but we don’t want him to wait any longer. We would love to find his happily ever after soon  even while he is in treatment. River has spent his life far to long waiting and we know moving him to our rescue was the right thing for him. Let's find him a forever home. He is so deserving!!!! If you adopt River  you will probably say you don’t understand why he wasn’t scooped up by another family. And you will be so thankful it was you. Interested in meeting River? www.uniteddobermanrescue.org

Meet 1 year old F Doberman  Ayzal  like Hazel without the H— Currently in a foster to adopt home! Your Smart  Sweet New Best Friend! At just 1.5 years old  Azo is ready to find the forever family she's been waiting for! This sweet girl has so much love to give and absolutely enjoys being around people. Whether she's meeting new friends or soaking up attention  Azo has a wonderful personality that makes her easy to fall in love with. Azo is also one smart cookie! She has completed private one-on-one training sessions and has learned her basic commands. She's a bright girl who can learn quickly  and continuing her training will be a great way to build her confidence  strengthen your bond  and help her keep reaching her full potential. Azo has also shown that she can handle large crowds.  This girl has the brains  the sweetness  and the potential to make an incredible companion. She's still young  still learning  and ready for someone who will invest in her and give her the life she deserves. Could Azo be the missing piece of your family? She's ready to trade training sessions for a lifetime of love  adventures  and a place to finally call home. Ayzal is in a foster to adopt home.

Scooby was saved with just HOURS LEFT after landing on the euthanasia list. This handsome boy was running out of time  but someone saw that his life was worth saving. Now  we get to show the world what an incredible dog he truly is. And honestly? Scooby might just be the whole package. This boy is potty trained  knows how to listen  follows directions  and is eager to learn. He’s treat-motivated and can pick up new commands in just 2–3 repetitions when treats are involved. He walks beautifully off leash with his person and enjoys getting out for adventures  including hikes. Scooby gets along with other dogs when given slow  proper introductions. He’s also living proof that a big dog doesn’t have to make a big fuss about everything. He ignores his foster’s chickens and remains calm around other animals  even when other dogs are barking. When something catches his attention on a hike  he’ll stop and observe until he’s satisfied there’s no threat rather than immediately reacting. Inside the home? He’s a dream. Scooby isn’t destructive  enjoys a good chew stick  and simply wants to be near his person. But here’s where this big guy will steal your heart… Scooby is a certified LOVE BUG. He wants to be petted on his nose and head all day  every day. He’s happiest just being close to his human  soaking up affection and reminding you that sometimes the best part of life is having a loyal companion by your side. Think about it. A dog who listens  learns quickly  enjoys adventures  can coexist peacefully with other animals  knows his manners  and wants nothing more than to love his people. This is the dog who was almost out of time. Scooby deserved more than the final hours he was given. He deserved a chance to be someone's best friend  hiking buddy  couch companion  and forever shadow. Now he needs someone to give him the one thing rescue cannot promise forever: a home of his own. Could that be you? If you're looking for a wonderful companion to welcome into your life  please consider Scooby. He has so much love to give  and his next chapter deserves to be filled with safety  adventures  affection  and the promise that he will never have to wonder if his time is running out again. Scooby is ready for his happily ever after. Let's make sure this boy's story ends with a family of his own. Fostered in California Apply to adopt Scooby through United Doberman Rescue & Canine Castaways: https://www.uniteddobermanrescue.org/

Meet Klaus! Handsome doesn't begin to cover it. This sweet  approximately 3½-year-old neutered Doberman is a gentle soul with a heart as big as his ears are perky  and he's ready to find the family he's been dreaming about.Klaus loves people of all ages  and he's a total pro with kids. He even has a 4-year-old human buddy who thinks he hung the moon. He's equally smooth with other dogs  getting along with both boys and girls  though he'd really love a female canine companion to share the couch with. Fair warning: Klaus is not a fan of cats  so his forever home needs to be cat-free.Klaus is a smart cookie  too. He knows his basic commands and has an excellent recall  so when you call  he comes running (probably with a goofy grin). He's never possessive of his food or toys  and he is affectionate to the core  the kind of dog who will happily lean into you for one more cuddle.He's up to date on his vaccinations and is currently being treated for allergies. Like any good student  Klaus has one subject he's still working on: leash walking. With a little patience  structure  and continued training  he'll be strutting down the sidewalk like a champ.Klaus has so much love to give. All he needs is a family who will offer patience  guidance  and most of all  a permanent place to call home. Could that be you?Learn more about adopting Klaus at https://www.uniteddobermanrescue.org/

Meet Brandy  a stunning 5-year-old AKC red Doberman beauty who is every bit as sweet as she is beautiful!Brandy has spent nearly her entire life devoted to one person. Since she was just 10 weeks old  she lived with her elderly human as his companion  and in true Doberman fashion  she took that job very seriously. Unfortunately  her owner recently had to move into assisted living  and his family made the difficult decision to find Brandy a new home where she can receive all the love  attention  and companionship she deserves.Brandy is a typical Dobe when it comes to her home and her person. She bonds closely with her human and will absolutely let strangers know she is there when they enter her territory. Once she knows you  though  you'll quickly see the sweet girl behind that beautiful red exterior.Brandy has done well with the other dogs in her home. Any introductions to dogs or other pets should be done slowly  correctly  and with plenty of time for everyone to become comfortable.Brandy has spent the last five years being someone's loyal companion  and now she's looking for someone who will be hers. She deserves a home that understands the devotion  intelligence  and protective nature that comes with loving a Doberman—and  most importantly  a family ready to make her part of their world again.This red beauty has so much love and loyalty left to give. Could Brandy be your girl?

Meet Penny!Penny is a sweet young girl who we estimate to be around 6 months old  and she has already been through more than any puppy should have to endure. Penny came to us from Animal Control in Wisconsin after suffering a severe broken leg. Despite everything she has been through  this little girl continues to show us just how resilient and loving she is.Penny’s leg may ultimately need to be amputated  but because she is still so young  we are confident that she will adapt incredibly well if that ends up being the best option for her. We will be working closely with our veterinary team and following their recommendations to make sure Penny receives whatever care is truly in her best interest.Right now  Penny is focused on being a puppy — learning  growing  and soaking up all the love she deserves. She is looking for a family who understands that she may have some extra medical needs along the way  but who also sees what we see: a bright  beautiful little girl with so much life ahead of her.Penny has already overcome so much in her short life  and we cannot wait to see what her future holds. She deserves a family who will give her patience  love  and the chance to show everyone just how special she is.Penny may have had a rough start  but we know her best days are still ahead.

Meet Diamond! Diamond is a beautiful purebred blue Dober-girl somewhere between 1 and 2 years old  with a youthful  goofy spirit that makes her seem even younger. She is smart  playful  curious  and has the kind of personality that makes you smile just watching her figure out the world.Diamond spent nearly a year at a boarding facility in California  so she is now discovering that the world is a MUCH bigger place than a kennel. New people? Interesting. New experiences? Hmmm... let's investigate. Weird things she has never seen before? She is working on it! The wonderful thing about Diamond is that she really tries to be the best girl. She wants to do the right thing  and you can almost see the wheels turning as she learns about all these new things she may not have experienced while living at the kennel. Give her a little patience  encouragement  and guidance  and she is eager to figure it out.It is also VERY apparent that Diamond has had some serious obedience training. She knows her commands and clearly understands what is expected of her. She sits when its leash time  sits when the door opens and waits for you to tell her to go through. We suspect she may have spent some time as a board-and-train at the kennel she was at because this girl has some impressive skills!She loves going for walks and is a fantastic car passenger. Diamond is quite happy riding shotgun  taking in the scenery and making sure everyone is following proper driving procedures. And then there is the ball. Diamond LOVES to play ball. Throw it  she is on it. Throw it again  she is ready. And again. And again. We are pretty sure she would happily make ball retrieval her full-time career if someone would just keep the paycheck coming in tennis balls. Diamond is dog-friendly. Once she feels comfortable with humans  her playful personality comes out. She is affectionate  curious  and wants to be involved in whatever her people are doing.She isn't normally much of a talker  but put her in a crate and suddenly she has a LOT to say. Apparently  Diamond believes being crated is the perfect time to provide everyone within earshot with her thoughts on the situation. She is also learning about some of the stranger things that come with being a house dog. The robot vacuum  or computer printer  for example  neither has not exactly won her endorsement. She is still reviewing those particular pieces of technology. She clearly does not approve.Diamond is such a fun combination of youthful energy  intelligence  sweetness  and personality. She is learning every day  and watching her gain confidence as she experiences new things is pretty special. She would love a family who will continue her training  give her plenty of exercise and mental stimulation  play lots of ball  take her on adventures  and help her learn that all those new and sometimes weird things in the world are actually okay. Diamond tends to be very clingy once she determines you are her person.She does startle easily by new things so a fully fenced yard will be required. Clearly learning about the outside world in her foster home.Diamond is fully vetted  spayed  microchipped  current on vaccinations  heartworm negative  and on preventative. She is ready to keep learning  keep playing  and most importantly  finally have a family of her own. Diamond is fostered in Arizona. Adopters will need to travel to meet and adopt. Learn more about Diamond and adopting with United Doberman Rescue at www.uniteddobermanrescue.org

ATLAS... PART-TIME GOOBER  FULL-TIME DOBERMAN SECURITY DETAIL We have a bit of a naming crisis on our hands. We are torn between calling him Atlas  because apparently his compass is full and he's trying to figure out which direction his life is supposed to go... Or Doby  because "Doby" sounds suspiciously like the name you give a dog who has entered the Witness Protection Program and is not at liberty to discuss his previous life. ️‍♂️And honestly  we're starting to think Doby has been instructed by his attorney to say nothing without his human present.Because here's what we know: This 1-year-old Doberman arrived with very little information and approximately 17 000 unanswered questions. He was dropped off at a foster's boarding facility without official approval  with almost no history. We were told he had lived with children  another dog  and that his name was Doby.That's it. Apparently  the rest of his biography was classified.When he first arrived  he was scared  confused and understandably unsure about what was happening. But once he started settling in  we discovered something important:THIS BOY IS A TOTAL DOG NUT.LOVES other dogs.Playing? YES.Romping? YES.Wrestling? ABSOLUTELY.Running around like someone just announced free pizza? EVERY SINGLE TIME.He has been having a blast at daycare and absolutely LOVES hanging out with his canine friends.Give him another dog and suddenly the worried  uncertain boy disappears and the Doberman version of a professional WWE wrestler comes out.But then there's the other side of this handsome guy.He's a Doberman.And apparently his internal software came with the "Protect My People at All Costs" package pre-installed.Once he bonds with his humans  he is going to love them HARD. He will want to be with his people  know where his people are and keep tabs on his people.Strangers?Well...Strangers may apply for access. He will probably want to personally review their credentials  references  employment history and possibly their intentions regarding the snack cabinet.This is why Atlas/Doby is NOT a first-time Doberman.He needs someone who already understands this breed and knows that a Doberman can be loving  goofy  affectionate  intelligent  loyal and protective......sometimes all before breakfast.He is young and still needs refinement. He needs continued training  structure  consistency and someone who will help him learn that he doesn't have to worry about everything going on around him.And let's be clear:He WANTS to learn.He's young. He's smart. He's curious. He's playful. He's figuring things out.He's not looking for someone who expects a perfectly finished product.He's looking for someone who looks at him and says:"Yep. I know Dobermans. I got this."Because when he decides you're his person  you're probably going to know about it.❤️ You will be loved.️ You will be protected.You will be monitored.You will probably be followed into the bathroom. And heaven help the suspicious-looking Amazon delivery driver.Because of his fear and uncertainty  a secure physical fence is non-negotiable. We require a tall privacy fence or very tall chain-link fence. No invisible fences  tie-outs or unfenced properties.He has previously lived with children ages 1 through 9 and two other dogs  a little Yorkie and a large Lab. We're told those dogs apparently had him thoroughly trained in the art of knowing his place. Now he's discovering that life can actually be pretty fantastic.He gets to play with dogs. He gets to wrestle. He gets to romp. He gets to make friends.And slowly  he's learning that people can be trusted too.What Atlas/Doby needs now is his person. Not just anybody.Not someone who thinks  "I've never owned a Doberman  but how hard could it be?"Nope. We're looking for an experienced Doberman owner who understands the breed  understands protective behavior  enjoys training and is willing to help this young guy grow into the confident  well-mannered Doberman he's capable of becoming.He isn't perfect. He's not supposed to be. He's one year old.He's a work in progress with a giant heart  a goofy personality  a serious dog-playing addiction and a security system that apparently cannot be turned off.Underneath the uncertainty is a very special dog waiting for someone who will take the time to earn his trust.He may steal your heart. He may steal your couch. He may steal your personal space.And there is a very good chance he will steal your other dog's dignity during a wrestling match. ❤️He just needs someone willing to help him figure out where he belongs.Which brings us right back to the name...Atlas? Because his compass is full.Doby? Because apparently he's in Witness Protection. ️‍♂️We're taking votes.Whatever we eventually call him  this boy is ready for a new chapter  preferably one involving good people  good dogs  plenty of wrestling and absolutely no more mysterious plot twists.❤️ United Doberman Rescue www.uniteddobermanrescue.org

MEET MAGGIE  THE BLUE BEAUTY WITH A BIG PERSONALITY! 5-year-old blue purebred Doberman. Dog-friendly. Fabulous. Absolutely  positively NO CATS.This stunning blue Doberman Pinscher has entered the building  and she would like everyone to know that she is fabulous. Maggie is beautiful  sweet  loyal  and equipped with just the right amount of Doberman sass. She has a big heart  a fun personality  and absolutely no intention of being a wallflower.Through no fault of her own  changes in her family's circumstances meant Maggie lost the home she knew. Now this gorgeous girl is ready to turn the page and find the people who will make her next chapter her forever chapter.Her resume:✨ Blue and beautiful. Yes  she knows.✨ Sweet and loyal. Once you're her person  you're her person.✨ Sass level: just right. Not too much  not too little. Doberman standard.✨ Easy to get along with. A real people-pleaser  unless there's a snack involved  in which case she'd like to discuss this development.And Maggie has exciting news... SHE LIKES DOGS! She loves having other dogs around and would be happy to share her humans  her toys  her adventures  and probably her opinions with a compatible four-legged roommate.Now  the kitty question.   Maggie's answer is a firm no. Maggie has a high prey drive for little critters  and she is not a fan of cats. It's not personal  it's just who she is. Her forever home needs to be cat-free. No cats  no way  no exceptions  no "but he's really friendly." Please don't ask. Maggie has made up her mind  and she's a Doberman  so she's not changing it.What Maggie wants in her people:This girl is ready for FUN! She wants a family who will include her in life  give her stability and structure  and let her be the silly  loving  slightly sassy Doberman she was born to be.Maggie is not looking for a temporary pit stop. She is looking for HER PEOPLE. The kind of people who will say  "Yes  Maggie  you may come with us." Going for a walk? Maggie's coming. Adventure? Maggie's coming. Road trip? Maggie is already in the car.️ Couch time? Obviously Maggie is coming. Someone has a snack? Maggie would like to discuss this development.She is a loyal companion with an enormous heart  and once she knows you are her people  you can expect plenty of Doberman devotion.Maggie is fully ready to leave her past behind and get busy living her best life. She has beauty  brains  personality  and dog-friendliness. All she needs is the forever family who sees what a special girl she is.Maggie is blue. Maggie is beautiful.Maggie is dog-friendly.Maggie is NOT cat-friendly  and that's okay.Maggie has Doberman sass.Maggie has a giant heart.And Maggie is READY to be someone's best friend!Think your home might be Maggie's happily-ever-after? Apply to adopt this gorgeous girl today! United Doberman Rescue | www.uniteddobermanrescue.org

Meet purebred Doberman Vinny! Meet Vinny  a handsome 6-7 year-old black and rust purebred Doberman Pinscher! Vinny is a true gentleman who has been there  done that  and is ready to find a loving family to call his own.Due to changes in his family’s circumstances  Vinny is looking for a fresh start and a new forever home. Through no fault of his own  he has lost the home he knew and is now ready for a new chapter with a family who will give him the love  patience  and stability he deserves.Vinny is a loyal  devoted boy with a soft heart and plenty of personality. He’s the kind of dog who forms deep connections with his people and loves being close to those he trusts. Whether he’s relaxing by your side or soaking up some attention  Vinny is happiest when he’s with his humans. Check him out playing with other dogs: https://www.facebook.com/reel/4482537615294038After everything he’s been through  Vinny deserves a family who will show him just how wonderful life can be. If you’re looking for a mature  loyal Doberman gentleman with a heart of gold  Vinny may be the perfect match for you!If you’re ready to give Vinny the forever home he deserves  apply today to adopt!www.uniteddobermanrescue.org

Meet Tootsie! Tootsie is a stunning cropped and docked purebred Doberman girl  somewhere between 1 and 3 years young. Her birth certificate is missing  so we're calling her "forever young."Her early chapters were rough. She survived on the streets of Los Angeles  was picked up by the dog catcher  and then spent over two months in a loud LA shelter where the barking never stopped. For a sensitive Doberman  that was a lot. But she made it  and now she gets to find out what a good life feels like. And she is blossoming! In foster care  Tootsie has picked her one person: her foster mom. Where mom goes  Tootsie follows  and she keeps one eye on her at all times. Trust is a brave thing to learn  and every little step forward is a win for Tootsie. Tootsie is great with the resident cats  dogs and even horses!A few fun facts about Tootsie:She loves her crate. It's her cozy little studio apartment  and sometimes she needs a gentle "hey  come join the party" to venture out. We think that's perfectly reasonable  because who doesn't love a good safe space?She is fully potty trained. Star student!She is fully vetted and spayed.Her best pal was a tiny Yorkie. Yes  shes great with little dogs and even cats! It is adorable.Loud surprises like car horns  sirens  and bangs make her world spin  so calm and cozy is her love language. She will need a home that understands fear responses in dogs and can work with building trust.Tootsie's dream home has:A high  secure fenced yard  because this girl is a serious flight risk and could probably star in her own escape movie.A GPS collar for extra peace of mind. She will come with one from the rescue. She is also microchipped:)A friendly canine buddy to be her forever pal and guide  because Tootsie is a dog's dog and a home with other dogs is a must.Lots of patience and love for her healing and bonding journey.We aren't giving up on this girl  and one day she will have a family to call her own. Could it be you? A family with expereince with this breed preferred  fenced yard and other canines for doggy support. Yes Tootsie will benefit from having her own personal support animal:)Please read our adoption policy  and if you qualify  apply at www.uniteddobermanrescue.org

Meet Doberman puppy Onyx!  Onyx is a melanistic Doberman  with a gentle soul and a powerful comeback story. He and his brother Bonsai were found as strays and came into rescue in rough shape—both boys were very skinny  one required stitches  and the other was running a fever. All healthy now and fully vetted  vaccinated and neutered  he is ready to find his forever home! Thanks to prompt veterinary care  good nutrition  and lots of love  both pups have made an amazing recovery and are now doing great! Onyx is dog friendly and does well around other pups. . Like any puppy his age  Onyx is curious  learning about the world  and ready to bond deeply with his people. He’s at the perfect stage of life to grow  train  and build confidence alongside a committed forever family. Onyx has already proven how resilient he is—now he’s ready for a safe  loving forever home where he can continue to thrive. If you’re looking for a pup to grow with and love for a lifetime  Onyx might be your perfect match. www.uniteddobermanrescue.org

Meet Dragon  a handsome 3-year-old Doberman with a big playful heart!Dragon is a really good boy who loves his people and thrives on affection and attention. He does great with people and dogs once he knows them  and he currently has other foster dog friends that he plays with on a regular basis but can be selective of others.Dragon can just be weary of strangers at first  so he does best with slow introductions to new people and new animals to set him up for success. He is currently on Prozac to help him feel more settled and confident  and he is doing well on it.He'll be happiest with an experienced handler who understands the breed  can read his cues  and can continue his routine. In return  you'll get a loyal  goofy  intelligent and affectionate best friend who loves toys  car rides  and an active lifestyle.Dragon is housetrained  crate trained  and neutered. He needs a home with a fenced yard  no cats  and older/considerate kids only.If you're looking for a fun  loving companion and can give him a little patience up front with new faces  Dragon might be your perfect match!
